name: v66_cfi_guidance_breadth_boost
hypothesis: The v65 CFI guidance near-miss was low-correlation and just below the Fitness gate; increasing estimate-breadth weight may improve stability without changing the parent mechanism.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_cfi_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_cfi_maxguidance) / (2 * assets)), 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_cfi_maxguidance - anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_cfi_minguidance) / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_cfi_number, 63), 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Minimal v65 rescue: move 10% weight from magnitude/range into breadth.

name: v66_cfi_guidance_subindustry
hypothesis: Investing-cash-flow guidance is capital-intensity dependent; subindustry ranking may improve comparability and lift Fitness while preserving low correlation.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_cfi_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_cfi_maxguidance) / (2 * assets)), 126), subindustry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_cfi_maxguidance - anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_cfi_minguidance) / abs(assets), 126), subindustry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_cfi_number, 63), 126), subindustry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Peer-group rescue analogous to v64, but stop if it loses Sharpe/Fitness.

name: v66_cfi_guidance_qf_timing
hypothesis: Quarterly CFI guidance may shift timing enough to raise Fitness without becoming a capex/reported-FCF near-neighbor.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_qf_nd_cfi_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_qf_nd_cfi_maxguidance) / (2 * assets)), 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_qf_nd_cfi_maxguidance - anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_qf_nd_cfi_minguidance) / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(anl4_fs_detail_estimate_1qf_v4_nd_cfi_number, 63), 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Quarterly timing sibling of the v65 annual CFI near-miss.

name: v66_cfi_guidance_stronger_risk_relief
hypothesis: A slightly stronger risk-relief term may improve drawdown-adjusted Fitness for the CFI guidance signal while keeping top correlation below 0.68.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_cfi_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_cfi_maxguidance) / (2 * assets)), 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_cfi_maxguidance - anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_cfi_minguidance) / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_cfi_number, 63), 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_90_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry)
notes: Adds only 10% beta-slope relief; reject if alpha strength falls below v65.
